tagline: Every command, prompt and snippet you keep forgetting.
brief: A native, keyboard-first macOS library for the terminal commands, AI prompts and code snippets developers reuse but can't remember. Local-first, fast, precise.
criteria: Success: reads at 16 px in the menu bar as a one-colour template, avoids the >_ / chest / cards clichés, and ties to typing and recall.

concepts.name: Cursor-S
concepts.idea: An S whose top terminal breaks off into a blinking cursor: type it once, Stash keeps it.
rationale: One folded stroke = three stacked rows: a library, and an S
Dedicated small-size cut keeps the cursor gap open at 16 px
The cursor blinks in amber on dark grounds and in motion

recommendation: Cursor-S in Stash Indigo #4636D6 with a Cursor Amber #FFB224 accent on dark and indigo grounds.
next_steps: Apply the new app icon and menu bar icon to the app
